signature: errcode 507035: device error type 3 on tiny (1,128) fp16 dim=-1
root_cause: Suspected DataCopyPad/tile path on a tiny non-aligned row; SIMT path not forced
workaround: Force SIMT for short non-aligned rows, or use R=1 per-row copies

signature: triton route on 950PR: wheel builds, staged eval crashes (three submissions, refunded)
root_cause: 950PR triton-ascend path not usable at staged eval

signature: official triton example: 10/20 cases (2 grid.y>65535 launch failures + wrong/NaN outputs)
workaround: Flat/pair kernel for half==1; [R,C] tile with scalar row base otherwise

signature: 910B swiglu half=1 (outer=1000003): tile path 8.08ms vs baseline 0.095ms (0.012x); SIMT dispatch is compiled out because SWIGLU_HAS_SIMT=0
root_cause: R=1, W=1 -> one DataCopyPad per output element; DeInterleave is not implemented on dav_c220
workaround: Gather-based tiny-row path: contiguous 2*C load, even/odd offset tensors, C contiguous store

signature: 910B swiglu: no matching function for call to 'GatherMask' in swiglu_kernel.cpp
root_cause: GatherMask is a masked-reduction API; its signature is (dst, src, src1Pattern/uint8, reduceMode, mask, GatherMaskParams, rsvdCnt), not an even/odd element gather.
workaround: Use Gather Level 2: AscendC::Gather(dst, src, srcOffset, 0, count) with srcOffset LocalTensor<uint32_t> holding [0,2,4,...] and [1,3,5,...].

signature: 910B swiglu tiny path: no matching function for call to 'Gather' (float dst from half/bf16 src)
root_cause: Gather is templated on one T for dst and src; the agent gathered directly into float scratch.
workaround: Gather into LocalTensor<T> x0/x1, then Cast(x0f, x0, CAST_NONE, n) and Cast(x1f, x1, CAST_NONE, n).

signature: 910B swiglu tiny path: 10/12 cases, MERE 43.4/39.0 on (1000003,2) dim=1 and (363,367,14) dim=-1
root_cause: Gather called in-place on xLocal and the same tensor passed as x0/x1; the second Gather reads overwritten data.
workaround: Use distinct inLocal, x0Local[T], x1Local[T] buffers; Gather(x0Local, inLocal, off0), Gather(x1Local, inLocal, off1).
